newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia dlr tests support, near term seen bearish.
newsitem.headline: Australia dlr tests support, near term seen bearish.

text.p: The Australian dollar survived two tests of support on Thursday, but traders said the immediate outlook was bearish for the unit despite positive longer term fundamentals.
The dollar dipped to as low as US$0.7805 on offshore selling and as the market ignored a substantial improvement in Australia's trade balance.
By 5.00 p.m. (0700 GMT), the Australian dollar was trading at US$0.7815/20, its lowest local close in a month, down from an early US$0.7837/42 and a local close on Wednesday of US$0.7840/45.
